1.content:
# Camunda 8.7 — Zeebe Storage

Ported from the Camunda Grafana dashboard `8.7.35-zeebe.json`. Metrics are expected in Grail as **Micrometer meter names** (`zeebe.stream.processor.records.total`), pushed straight from Camunda over OTLP with `delta` temporality — see `runbook-dynatrace.md`.

**Companion dashboards:** `8.7-zeebe-01-overview.json` · `8.7-zeebe-02-processing.json` · `8.7-zeebe-04-cluster.json` · `8.7-zeebe-05-resources.json`

2.content:
## Journal
Raft journal: appends, flushes, segments and compaction.

3.title: Number of log segments

4.title: Journal append data rate
4.description: The rate, in KiB/s, of data appended to the local journal

5.title: Journal append rate
5.description: The rate of entries appended to the local journal (by entry count), per pod, per partition

6.title: Journal Flush Latency
6.query:
timeseries {
    mean = avg(atomix.journal.flush.time),
    p50 = percentile(atomix.journal.flush.time, 50)
  },
  by: {k8s.pod.name},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
6.description: Overall latency to flush the complete journal

7.title: Journal Flush Latency
7.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(atomix.journal.flush.time, 50),
    p90 = percentile(atomix.journal.flush.time, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.journal.flush.time, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
7.description:
Overall latency distribution to flush the journal

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

8.title: Journal append latency
8.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(atomix.journal.append.latency, 50),
    p90 = percentile(atomix.journal.append.latency, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.journal.append.latency, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
8.description:
Time spent appending in the local journal

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

9.title: Journal append latency
9.query:
timeseries {
    p90 = percentile(atomix.journal.append.latency, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.journal.append.latency, 99),
    p50 = percentile(atomix.journal.append.latency, 50),
    mean = avg(atomix.journal.append.latency)
  },
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
9.description: Quantile distribution of time spent appending in the journal, per partition, per pod

10.title: Segment Creation Time
10.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(atomix.segment.creation.time, 50),
    p90 = percentile(atomix.segment.creation.time, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.segment.creation.time, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
10.description: Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

11.title: Segment Allocation Time
11.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(atomix.segment.allocation.time, 50),
    p90 = percentile(atomix.segment.allocation.time, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.segment.allocation.time, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
11.description:
Time spent pre-allocating a segment

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

12.title: Segment Flush Latency
12.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(atomix.segment.flush.time, 50),
    p90 = percentile(atomix.segment.flush.time, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.segment.flush.time, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
12.description:
Overall latency distribution to flush a single segment

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

13.title: Segment Flush Latency
13.query:
timeseries {
    mean = avg(atomix.segment.flush.time),
    p50 = percentile(atomix.segment.flush.time, 50)
  },
  by: {k8s.pod.name},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
13.description: Overall latency of flushing a single segment

14.title: Compacting time
14.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(atomix.compaction.time.ms, 50),
    p90 = percentile(atomix.compaction.time.ms, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.compaction.time.ms, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
14.description: Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

15.title: Last Written Index Update
15.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(atomix.last.flushed.index.update, 50),
    p90 = percentile(atomix.last.flushed.index.update, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.last.flushed.index.update, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
15.description:
Time spent updating the last written index

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

16.title: Segment Seek Latency
16.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(atomix.journal.seek.latency, 50),
    p90 = percentile(atomix.journal.seek.latency, 90),
    p99 = percentile(atomix.journal.seek.latency, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
16.description:
Overall latency distribution to seek to an index

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

17.content:
## Logstream
Log appender, sequencer and write flow control.

18.title: Sequencer Batch Entry Count
18.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.sequencer.batch.size, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.sequencer.batch.size, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.sequencer.batch.size, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
18.description:
Shows the distribution of the # of entries per batch

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

19.title: Sequencer Batch Size (KB)
19.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.sequencer.batch.length.bytes, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.sequencer.batch.length.bytes, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.sequencer.batch.length.bytes, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
19.description:
Shows the distribution of the size of each enqueued batch, in kilobytes.

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

20.title: Written commands
20.description: Rate of commands written per second by the log storage appender on the leader

21.title: Written events
21.description: Rate of events written per second by the log storage appender on the leader

22.title: Written rejections
22.description: Rate of written rejections per second by the log storage appender on the leader

23.title: Number of deferred appends due to backpressure

24.title: Appender Flow-Control
24.query:
timeseries {
    in_flight_for_partition = avg(zeebe.backpressure.inflight.append.count),
    limit_for_partition = avg(zeebe.backpressure.append.limit)
  },
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true

25.title: Accepted writes by source
25.description: The number of records accepted by flow control per second, organized by partition and write source (e.g. processing result, scheduled tasks etc.)

26.title: Rejected writes by source and reason
26.description: The number of records rejected by flow control per second, organized by partition and write source (e.g. processing result, scheduled tasks etc.)

27.title: Write Rate Limits
27.query:
timeseries {
    current_limit_on = avg(zeebe.flow.control.write.rate.limit),
    maximum_limit_on = avg(zeebe.flow.control.write.rate.maximum)
  },
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
| filter arrayMax(current_limit_on) != 0
| filter arrayMax(maximum_limit_on) != 0
27.description: The current and maximum permissible write rate limit per partition. When current is smaller than the maximum, throttling is in effect

28.title: Measured exporting rate
28.query:
timeseries exporting_rate = avg(zeebe.flow.control.exporting.rate),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))}
| filter arrayMax(exporting_rate) != 0
28.description: Measured average exporting rate which may be used to throttle write rate.

29.title: Written commands
29.query:
timeseries appended_per_sec = sum(zeebe.log.appender.record.appended, rate:1s, filter:{recordType == "COMMAND"}),
  by: {recordType, valueType, intent},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayAvg(appended_per_sec)
| fields recordType, valueType, intent, value
29.description: Distribution of written commands by the leading log storage appender

30.title: Written events
30.query:
timeseries appended_per_sec = sum(zeebe.log.appender.record.appended, rate:1s, filter:{recordType == "EVENT"}),
  by: {valueType, intent},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayAvg(appended_per_sec)
| fields valueType, intent, value
30.description: Distribution of written events by the leading log storage appender

31.title: Written rejections
31.query:
timeseries appended_per_sec = sum(zeebe.log.appender.record.appended, rate:1s, filter:{recordType == "COMMAND_REJECTION"}),
  by: {valueType, intent},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayAvg(appended_per_sec)
| fields valueType, intent, value
31.description: Distribution of written rejections by the leading log storage appender

32.title: Partition Load
32.query:
timeseries partition_load = max(zeebe.flow.control.partition.load),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))}
| filter arrayMax(partition_load) > 0
| fieldsAdd value = arrayLast(partition_load)
| fields partition, value
32.description: The current partition load is defined by the current write rate divided by the write rate limit per partition. The partition load panel will display no data unless the flow control rate write limits are enabled.

33.content:
## RocksDB
State store memory, SST files, compactions and access latency.

34.title: RocksDB Memory usage
34.query:
timeseries {
    table_readers = sum(zeebe.rocksdb.memory.estimate.table.readers.mem, default:0),
    all_mem_tables = sum(zeebe.rocksdb.memory.size.all.mem.tables, default:0),
    block_cache = sum(zeebe.rocksdb.memory.block.cache.usage, default:0),
    num_keys = sum(zeebe.rocksdb.live.estimate.num.keys, default:0)
  },
  by: {k8s.pod.name, partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
| fieldsAdd total_bytes = table_readers[] + all_mem_tables[] + block_cache[] + (num_keys[] * 10)
| fieldsRemove table_readers, all_mem_tables, block_cache, num_keys
34.description:
Sum of memtable, table reader and cache memory capacity.

Ported from Grafana: Four-metric sum, as in the original. The `num_keys * 10` term is Grafana's rough estimate of key-count memory and is kept verbatim; the original applied `rate()` to that gauge, which was a bug, so the gauge value is used directly.

35.title: Estimated Number of Keys
35.description: Estimated total number of keys in the database per column family

36.title: Estimated Live Data
36.description: Estimated amount of live data in bytes per column family

37.title: Approx. size of all mem tables
37.description:
Returns approximate size of active, unflushed immutable, and pinned immutable memtables (bytes) per partition.

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/e66199d848cd484b816d07359f1dc0f0b99e5351/include/rocksdb/db.h#L807

38.title: Approx. current all mem table size
38.description:
Approximate size of active and unflushed immutable memtables (bytes) per partition.

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/e66199d848cd484b816d07359f1dc0f0b99e5351/include/rocksdb/db.h#L803

39.title: Approx. current active mem table size
39.description:
Approximate size of active memtable (bytes) per partition.

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/e66199d848cd484b816d07359f1dc0f0b99e5351/include/rocksdb/db.h#L799

40.title: Block cache capacity
40.description: The block cache capacity per column family

41.title: Block cache usage
41.description:
The current usage of the block cache per column family

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/618bf638aabce21262228509e9f99c1c13de2b57/include/rocksdb/cache.h#L261

42.title: Pinned block cache usage
42.description:
The current pinned usage of the block cache per column family

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/618bf638aabce21262228509e9f99c1c13de2b57/include/rocksdb/cache.h#L261

43.title: Total size of live SST files
43.description:
Total size (bytes) of all SST  files belong to the latest LSM tree.

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/e66199d848cd484b816d07359f1dc0f0b99e5351/include/rocksdb/db.h#L882

44.title: Total size of all SST files
44.description:
Total size (bytes) of all SST files.

WARNING: may slow down online queries if there are too many files.

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/e66199d848cd484b816d07359f1dc0f0b99e5351/include/rocksdb/db.h#L878

45.title: Write stopped
45.description:
Return 1 if write has been stopped.

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/e66199d848cd484b816d07359f1dc0f0b99e5351/include/rocksdb/db.h#L908

46.title: Actual write delay rate
46.description:
The current actual delayed write rate. 0 means no delay.

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/e66199d848cd484b816d07359f1dc0f0b99e5351/include/rocksdb/db.h#L905

47.title: Number of entries in immutable mem Tables
47.description: Return sum of number of entries in all the immutable mem tables.

48.title: Running flush
48.description:
Returns the number of currently running flushes.

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/e66199d848cd484b816d07359f1dc0f0b99e5351/include/rocksdb/db.h#L783

49.title: Running compactions
49.description:
The number of currently running compactions.

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/e66199d848cd484b816d07359f1dc0f0b99e5351/include/rocksdb/db.h#L791

50.title: Table Reader Memory
50.description:
Returns estimated memory used for reading SST tables, excluding memory used in block cache (e.g., filter and index blocks).

https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/blob/e66199d848cd484b816d07359f1dc0f0b99e5351/include/rocksdb/db.h#L832

51.title: Column Family Access Latency 99th percentile

52.content:
## Snapshots
Snapshot creation, size and replication.

53.title: Snapshot Count
53.description: Total number of committed snapshots on disk

54.title: Snapshot Operation Duration
54.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.snapshot.duration, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.snapshot.duration, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.snapshot.duration, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
54.description:
Approximate duration of taking a single snapshot from the processor point-of-view (without replication or committing).

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

55.title: Snapshot Size
55.description: Size in bytes of snapshots on disk

56.title: Snapshot Files Sizes (1m)
56.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.snapshot.file.size.megabytes, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.snapshot.file.size.megabytes, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.snapshot.file.size.megabytes, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
56.description:
Distribution of snapshot file sizes - each snapshot may be comprised of many files, and this shows approximately how "big" files there are and how many "small" files.

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

57.title: Number of files in a snapshot
